name: Lady Xuanwen Giving Instruction on the Rites of Zhou
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on silk
summary: This painting by Chen Hongshou depicts the story of Xuanwen Jun, or Lady of Literary Propagation, at a venerable age, instructing young scholars on the Confucian classics. It was painted for Chen’s aunt in celebration of her 60th birthday.  Chen’s painting style is archaic in the use of fine outline
